context_requirements: Renal tubular epithelium expressing NKCC2 (SLC12A1), NCC (SLC12A3), or ENaC for loop/thiazide/potassium-sparing diuretics; none of the nine lines are renal tubular
Mineralocorticoid receptor (NR3C1) signalling for aldosterone-antagonist activity; NR3C1 is expressed but no aldosterone-driven transcriptional program is active in these lines
For amiloride-class off-target effects, high expression of acid-sensing/amiloride-sensitive channels and active spliceosome dependence; only multiple myeloma lines showed this
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Induction of a coherent aldosterone/ENaC-dependent transcriptional signature (e.g., SGK1, PER1, NR3C1 targets)
Cell-line-selective growth arrest or apoptosis at 10 micromolar consistent with a specific diuretic target

evidence.supports: Amiloride, a potassium-sparing diuretic, induced apoptosis and spliceosome disruption in multiple myeloma lines, but activity was lineage-restricted and not observed in the non-myeloma lines used here

The diuretic-sensitive Na-K-2Cl cotransporter in fibroblasts performs only K+ self-exchange in quiescent cells and net K+ influx after serum stimulation, so no transcriptional output is expected at 6 h in serum-starved or vehicle-treated lines

Diuretic activity of Hibiscus sabdariffa required adrenalectomized rats and aldosterone analogue, indicating that the relevant transcriptional effects depend on mineralocorticoid signalling absent in these lines
